pages.title: Orca
pages.text: The $(o)Orca$() ($(o)Orcinus orca$()), or killer whale, is the largest dolphin and the top predator of the sea. Adult males reach about 8 metres, and their straight dorsal fin can stand nearly 2 metres tall; females are smaller with a curved fin.$(br2)Orcas live in matriarchal pods. Different populations specialise in fish, seals or even other whales, and they work together to catch them.$(br2)They are found in every ocean but are most common in cold waters.
